description: Read one deployment record by the RowKey or Slug from any search result (a hub case URL also works). The free preview returns title, a short description, company, industry, country, date, AI providers, technologies, quality tier, the original source Url, HubUrl and CompanyPages. A personal key adds the full record: deployment status and evidence strength, challenges, solution, architecture, reported outcomes and impact metrics. Use it before quoting a result's details or outcomes.

row_key.description: The RowKey or Slug returned by search tools; a case page URL also works.
